name: Zero-Dependency 3D Knowledge Galaxy Indexer
summary: Scans local markdown notes using Python standard library to build an interactive 3D force graph rendered via CDN without build frameworks.
steps: Place markdown notes inside `./notes` directory.
Run `build.py` using Python 3 standard library to extract filenames, categories, and `[[wikilinks]]` into `viewer/graph-data.js`.
Launch `server.py` serving `viewer/index.html` on port 4719.
Open `http://localhost:4719` in browser to view 3D force graph.
jarvis_use: Index local markdown vaults into a zero-dependency interactive 3D network graph.

name: Speech-to-Text Debounce Buffer Control
summary: Holds speech input dispatch until a sliding window timer expires, preventing mid-sentence voice cutoffs during conversational pauses.
steps: Initialize `webkitSpeechRecognition` listener.
Append incoming speech transcript chunks into an active text buffer.
Set or reset a sliding timer constant `FINISH_MS = 900` on each incoming speech chunk.
Dispatch full buffered transcript to backend `/chat` endpoint only after the timer completes without new audio.
jarvis_use: Stabilize voice input parsing by buffering transcript chunks until user speech pauses.

name: TTS Mute Toggle via URL Parameter
summary: Bypasses browser text-to-speech audio playback based on a URL query flag while preserving UI chat stream updates.
steps: Inspect browser location query string for `mute=1` parameter on page load or chat event.
If present, intercept response handler to bypass `speechSynthesis` playback call.
Continue updating chat UI with generated response text.
jarvis_use: Allow running the voice interface silently in quiet environments using simple URL flags.

name: Model-Agnostic Assistant Architecture
summary: Decouples core system mechanics (screen monitoring, tool calls, Telegram bridge) from backend LLM models via standard Web APIs and local wrapper scripts.
steps: Implement assistant side-effects and mechanics using standard browser Web APIs and local Python wrappers.
Route model completions through standard API endpoints or gateways like OpenRouter.
Allow switching underlying LLM models without modifying system mechanics or UI integrations.
jarvis_use: Ensure Jarvis core features remain modular and functional across different LLM providers.

name: Butler Persona System Prompt Pattern
summary: Configures system prompt instructions for a concise, polite butler persona with strict anti-hallucination and zero-padding rules.
steps: Define assistant persona as a polite, formal butler addressing the user as 'sir'.
Set strict response rules limiting answers to concise statements.
Instruct model to explicitly state absence of requested information in local notes rather than invent facts.
Inject system status metrics (note count, time) into the opening context prompt.
jarvis_use: Enforce precise, polite butler responses with strict note-relevance bounds.

name: Dynamic Tool Armory Integration Grid
summary: Provides a unified UI card grid for standard web integrations alongside input fields for custom MCP endpoints.
steps: Render a UI card layout listing popular service integrations (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Notion).
Provide a dedicated input box to accept custom Model Context Protocol (MCP) server endpoints.
Save configuration to local JSON configuration.
Expose active tools and MCP capabilities to the assistant context window.
jarvis_use: Enable dynamic registration of external APIs and custom local MCP tool endpoints.

name: Automated Focus Lock & Screen Drift Enforcement
summary: Monitors active screen content and tab focus to enforce task focus and deliver automated audio callouts upon distraction.
steps: Request screen recording permissions via browser screen capture APIs.
Start a focus timer target (e.g., 30 minutes).
Periodically sample active screen frame and tab focus.
If non-work websites or apps are detected, increment drift counter, refocus work tab, and trigger voice warning.
jarvis_use: Implement automated focus tracking and voice reminders for work productivity sessions.

name: Telegram Remote Control Assistant Bridge
summary: Links the central assistant system to a Telegram bot interface for voice message and text commands remotely.
steps: Create a Telegram Bot using BotFather API tokens.
Forward incoming voice notes and text messages to the assistant endpoint.
Process incoming queries through backend LLM/tool pipelines.
Return generated audio or text responses back to the Telegram chat thread.
jarvis_use: Control workstation Jarvis remotely via Telegram text and voice notes.

name: Automated Invoice Drafting and PDF Drive Upload
summary: Extracts invoice items during chat conversation, compiles a formatted PDF, and uploads it to Google Drive.
steps: Extract billing parameters (client name, line items, amounts) from conversation text.
Render structured HTML/CSS invoice template into PDF format.
Call Google Drive API via tool integration to save PDF in designated folder.
Return confirmation link to user.
jarvis_use: Automate client invoice generation and file storage via plain text requests.

name: Camera Vision Setup Monitoring ("JARVIS Eyes")
summary: Captures live web camera frames to allow visual inspection of the physical desk workspace and environment.
steps: Request camera permission using Web `navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia`.
Capture video frame on demand or on a periodic interval.
Pass image payload into vision-capable LLM prompt context.
Formulate natural language feedback on physical environment or setup.
jarvis_use: Allow Jarvis to visually inspect hardware setups or physical desk environments via webcam.
